name: atlas-helios-platform
description: PropertyInsight AI - Atlas & Helios: Storm Intelligence & Estimating Platform

scripts.build: npm run frontend:build && npm run backend:build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && docker-compose -f docker-compose.staging.yml up -d
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.test:packages: npm test --workspace=@alter/render-core && npm test --workspace=@alter/render-server && npm test --workspace=@atlas/radar-map
scripts.test:all: npm run test:packages && npm run test:backend

author: MiniMax Agent
